## Goal

A locked cosmetic's token offer in the Collection (card view strip items, and playmat, backdrop and card back tiles) no longer spends on the first click. The first click sends nothing. It draws an in-place `role="alertdialog"` that says "Unlock {cosmetic}? This spends 1 {Rare|Epic} token." with Confirm and Cancel, and Cancel takes the focus. Confirm sends exactly one `POST /api/tokens/redeem-cosmetic`, as the old click did. Cancel and Escape send nothing and put the offer back. Escape closes only the question, never the card view. The busy, refusal and redeemed states behave as today. The change is recorded as ruling R2480000 (amends R1953001), with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/2480.md`. The two new strings get zh-CN entries.
